results.name: U1 end-to-end success flow (shared tablet staff -> management review -> safety -> verification -> employee record)
U2 shared tablet: auto sign-out after submit, idle sign-out, nothing private left behind
U3 Spanish employee on a 320px phone: full report, no horizontal scroll, axe clean
U4 accessibility: axe on every main screen (light + dark), phone and tablet
U5 keyboard only: sign in, complete, sign and submit without a pointer
U6 network failure during submit keeps the answers; retry is idempotent (one record)
U7 temporary PIN first sign-in, PIN change, and wrong-PIN lockout message
U8 clarification loop: employee answers the question, management signs off, employee marks it seen
U9 management adds an employee; the new person signs in on a phone with the temporary PIN, sets a PIN and signs the survey
U10 outside work hours: the weekly report waits for the next shift; safety reports still work
U11 full-access manager: Restore & backup page; backup downloads a complete copy without sign-in secrets
U12 open portal: no sign-in screen; the weekly report asks for the PIN once, at signing; phone remembers the ID; shop tablet shows names
results.detail: phone (typed ID, remembered) and shop tablet (name grid) both sign with one PIN entry

results.name: U13 Face ID: offered after signing with the PIN; portal greets the person and signs in with Face ID; the weekly report is signed with Face ID (no PIN); More lists phones; management removes them
results.detail: offer after PIN signing, portal Face ID sign-in, report signed with Face ID (record says passkey), PIN fallback, removal by management

results.name: U14 everyday polish: no browser translation; home-screen tip on phones; My weekly reports card; calmer badges; reminders on More; Admin switch
results.detail: translate off, manifest/icons/worker served, install tip + dismiss, My week card, no staff badge, reminders section, admin switch

results.name: U15 QuickBooks Time: full access links an account (suggestion needs a click); the person sees My hours on Home (sample hours in the test copy)
results.detail: linking via suggestion, My hours card (7 days, sample label), hidden when not linked

results.name: U16 guided phone setup: Home card -> home-screen step (moving picture) -> Face ID step (PIN, then approve) -> reminders step -> all set
results.detail: card -> 3 steps with moving pictures -> Face ID set up inside the guide -> all set; card gone afterwards

results.name: U17 onboarding email: manager adds a person with an email -> email preview (test copy sends nothing) -> link on a phone -> choose PIN -> guided setup; setup list updates

detail.flow: add with email -> preview -> link -> PIN -> guided setup; link works once

results.name: U18 InnerPoints: full access links a person in Admin -> InnerPoints (suggestion needs a click) -> the person sees My InnerPoints on Home
results.detail: linked by a click in Admin; card on Home above My weekly reports; unlinked people see nothing

results.name: U19 management Home: managers land on Home with their own report, a Your team summary and the way into the dashboard
results.detail: managers: Home (own report, points, team summary) -> dashboard / accounts

results.name: U20 test copy: a full-access manager starts the sample data over from More (two taps); others cannot
results.detail: staff refused; full access resets with two taps; clock back to Oct 16

results.name: U21 company documents: staff see "Please read and sign" on Home, read the handbook and sign with the PIN; full access writes, previews and publishes a policy and sees who signed
results.detail: Home to-do -> read -> sign with PIN; manager: new -> save -> publish (two taps) -> who signed
